rules.statement: The solicitation and acceptance of money for assisting in the transaction of a business in court constitutes an offence under section 19 (b) of the Bribery Act.
rules.supporting_quote: That the purpose for which the money was solicited and accepted by the accused was to assist the complainant in the transaction of his business in the Magistrate's Court. Such a gratification, is not a legal gratification and is an offence under section 19 (b) of the Bribery Act

meta.parties: Fernando v. Republic of Sri Lanka
